title: Generalize KRN standards into portable principles and make Remember propose principles
body:
Outcome: KRN's records, standards, skills and task/brief templates state general principles that hold in any project, so KRN is one portable best-practice way to build anything; the Remember path turns an operator correction into a principle with the incident only as its evidence.
Evidence: operator 2026-11-19: standards must never be shaped by one incident, neither in a repo nor in KRN. Example: r-stop-skip-needs-session-proof (#1484) names one diagnosis; the principle is "verify the fact a cause depends on before stating it". Notes: .krn/runs/lead/handoff-first.md.
Do: audit .agents/records.json, standards/, .agents/skills and task/brief templates for incident- or KRN-repo-specific wording; rewrite each as its general principle or merge it into an existing one, grounded in recognised external practice where one exists; change the Remember path (krn standards propose / candidate ingest) so a proposal is a principle and the incident is evidence.
Proof: an audit list of rewritten/merged records with before/after wording, and a test that a proposal phrased as one incident is rejected or rewritten into a principle.
